title: Why Lumen Stock Soared Today
author: Keith Noonan
description: Lumen stock posted a 10.1% gain on Thursday after an investor named Daniel Hagan disclosed a large 5.4% stake in the company. The news of a major investor buying up shares helped spur bullish momentum, though Lumen still faces challenges like a large debt problem.
